description: Defines the EntityUniquePropertyOption class used for validation rules in the OrangeHRM system, including properties and methods for trimming, ignoring, and matching values.

classes.name: EntityUniquePropertyOption
classes.description: A class for configuring validation rules related to unique entity properties, including trimming options, ignore values, and match values.

methods.name: getTrimFunction
methods.description: Returns the closure used for trimming.

methods.name: hasIgnoreValues
methods.description: Checks if ignore values are set.

methods.name: setIgnoreId
methods.description: Adds an ID to ignore during validation.

methods.name: hasMatchValues
methods.description: Checks if match values are set.
